profile.description: 一款实验室用小型注射泵，用于以设定流速精确输送液体并进行持续输注。常用于微流控、化学加液、样品处理和生物实验中的定量给液。
profile.description_en: A compact laboratory syringe pump used to deliver liquids at a defined flow rate for precise, continuous infusion. It is commonly used for microfluidics, reagent addition, sample handling, and other experiments requiring accurate liquid dosing.
